decisions.statement: A tick that works takes the run of throws back to nothing.
A run of throws that reaches the threshold spends the ratchet.
A run of throws is counted in whole ticks beginning at `1`.
The ratchet names the service and the run and the threshold on the way out.
A loop that catches its own throw and logs that throw leaves the unit reading healthy.
Ending is the only thing the unit can see.

definition: the run of throws a service that keeps running is allowed before it has to end
